The `required_version` argument and the `required_providers` block both go directly inside the `terraform {}` block — `required_providers` is not a separate top-level block.
Each entry in `required_providers` is a map with two keys: `source` (the registry address) and `version` (the constraint string). Make sure both keys are present for the `aws` entry.
The `~>` operator needs the version written as `"~> 6.0"` — the tilde and greater-than sign together, followed by a space, then the version. After editing, run `terraform fmt` to catch any typos.
